title: WAMTA venue page data (venue.yml)
description: Drives the per-year /venue page rendered by _includes/venue.md. Each section may carry an optional Google Maps embed via map: { src, width, height }.

nav_hidden.description: When true, the page stays reachable but is omitted from the top navigation.

intro.description: Optional intro paragraph above the sections (Markdown allowed).

sections.description: Ordered list of titled sections (Conference Location, Accommodation, Directions, Travel by air, ...). Each section can optionally embed a map.
